import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
print(w.work_id.nunique(), w.year.isna().sum())
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w=w.dropna(subset=['year']).copy(); w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
print(pd.crosstab(w.genre,w.late))
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean(), g
e,g=est(w);print(e);print(g)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
grp=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
for i in range(2000):
  bs.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in grp]))[0])
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high','medium','low']:
  print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc])[0])
h=w[w.date_confidence!='low'];print('nolow',est(h)[0])
print('1866-1885',est(w[(w.year>1865)&(w.year<1886)])[0])
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o])[0])
print(w[w.late&(w[c]>0)].sample(4,random_state=1).work_id.tolist())
"
